key_insight: SCDM scales causal discovery in nonlinear time series by sharing a temporal predictor and causal-strength matrix across target-variable tasks.
engineering_relevance: Updating only a subset of targets per meta-episode reduces the need for exhaustive target-wise optimization in large temporal systems.
method: Treat each target variable as a task within a shared-parameter meta-learning framework.
Accumulate structural evidence through meta-episodes that update subsets of target tasks.
Convert the trained predictor into continuous directed causal scores using post-training graph readout.
evidence_signal: Experiments on controlled synthetic, neuroimaging-inspired, high-dimensional, and real-world temporal benchmarks report competitive causal recovery and improved scalability.
watch_item: The recovery guarantee requires fully observed delayed systems, a positive risk gap, and sufficiently small statistical, meta-optimization, and readout errors.
paper_title: SCDM: Scalable Causal Discovery in Nonlinear Temporal Systems with Meta-Learning
